page.overview:
What is Iron Valiant?

Iron Valiant is a mechanical, bipedal Pokémon that is very similar to Gallade in appearance, resembling a robotic/cybernetic version of it. It also has some vaguely traits of Gardevoir. It has squinted eyes with pixilated magenta irises, black pupils, and black scleras, giving it a scowling expression. Like Gallade, it has a bulky upper body, bladed arms, a helmet-like finned formation on top of its head, thick legs, a round torus-shaped abdominal section, two fins on the sides of its head, and a cape-like protrusion on its back much like Gallade's Mega Evolution. Like Gallade, it uses the plasma-basedm magenta blade-like protrusions from its arms, forming them into what appears to be one-handed twin staff-like blade. Its thick arms, consisting of gauntlets with large glowing magenta blades protruding from the sides, detach and combine to serve as this deadly double-edged weapon. The side of its head form two white spikes that flare outward from both sides. Its head is covered by a green curved plate resembling a knight's helmet, with two cone-shaped structures at the back of its head, and a teal head crest, also somewhat akin to a gladiator's helmet, bearing the primary trait of a Gallade. The helmet has short pigtail-like formations at the back and is slightly curled, (bearing a slight resemblance to Gardevoir's crest as well). A glowing magenta, slightly cylindrical core serves as a centerpiece on its chest. Four petal-shaped white and green guards tinged with magenta at the ends adorn its torso, resembling Gallade's cape.

A shiny Iron Valiant has its entire metal plating in a light steel-gray color, with the magenta interal glow being retained for its core, blades, eyes and parts of its cape.

However, unlike its noble counterparts Gallade and Gardevoir, Iron Valiant is ruthless and cold-blooded, never hesitant to cleave anyone it considers as its enemies on its path with its scythes. Like all Future Paradox Pokémon, Iron Valian can enter a "sleep mode" in which its magenta glowing parts and eyes go dark, and it lowers its head and goes into a bowing position.

Iron Valiant was created by a mad scientist in pursuit of creating the strongest -type Pokémon in existence. Like Gallade, Iron Valiant can use its bladed arms as a weapon. It unsheathes the plasma-based, magenta gauntlet-like blades, removing them entirely from its body, and welding them together like a double-bladed staff in which it uses to fight its opponents. It can do this in the blink of an eye, and then quickly reattach each blade onto its arms.
